name: lemeng.customer_analysis.day
_note: 乐檬 customer_analysis（nhsoft.report.ai.customeranalysis.find）——按门店块扇出的子管线（#1314 占位行已内置）。
本块 0 家门店有数据时写 1 行占位（branch_num=NULL, chunk_n_matched=0），父侧负责整天判空。
src.rest 必须申报 data.schema：0 行响应时引擎按申报建空表（否则下游绑定失败）。

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(code AS INTEGER) AS code, CAST(msg AS VARCHAR) AS msg
 FROM read_json_auto('/workspace/.duckle-raw/customer-analysis-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json')
 WHERE CAST(code AS INTEGER) <> 0

properties.message: customer_analysis 网关非 0 code（{rows} 条）：chunk ${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}/${ITER_ITEM_N_CHUNKS} bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}。raw 见 /workspace/.duckle-raw/customer-analysis-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json

properties.sql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(content AS JSON), '$.result.total_count') AS BIGINT) AS total_count,
         CAST(json_array_length(json_extract(CAST(content AS JSON), '$.result.rows')) AS BIGINT) AS n_rows
  FROM read_text('/workspace/.duckle-raw/customer-analysis-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json')
) t
WHERE t.total_count IS DISTINCT FROM t.n_rows

properties.message: 网关自相矛盾：total_count 与返回行数不等（{rows} 条）——响应被截断，拒绝写湖。raw 见 /workspace/.duckle-raw/customer-analysis-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(req.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       per.branch_code AS branch_code,
       per.branch_name AS branch_name,
       per.time_period AS time_period,
       per.customer_nums AS customer_nums,
       per.customer_vip_nums AS customer_vip_nums,
       per.customer_vip_money AS customer_vip_money,
       per.receive_money AS receive_money,
       per.item_sale_cost AS item_sale_cost,
       per.item_sale_profit AS item_sale_profit,
       per.branch_num IS NOT NULL AS matched
FROM (SELECT CAST(j.value AS BIGINT) AS branch_num FROM json_each('${ITER_ITEM_BRANCH_NUMS_JSON}') j) req
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT CAST(r.branch_num AS BIGINT) AS branch_num,
         CAST(r.branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
         CAST(r.branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
         CAST(r.time_period AS VARCHAR) AS time_period,
         CAST(r.customer_nums AS BIGINT) AS customer_nums,
         CAST(r.customer_vip_nums AS BIGINT) AS customer_vip_nums,
         CAST(r.customer_vip_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS customer_vip_money,
         CAST(r.receive_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS receive_money,
         CAST(r.item_sale_cost AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS item_sale_cost,
         CAST(r.item_sale_profit AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS item_sale_profit
  FROM input r
) per ON per.branch_num = req.branch_num

SELECT '${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}' AS batch_id,
       CAST(${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK} AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
       CAST('${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
       CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(time_period AS VARCHAR) AS time_period,
       CAST(customer_nums AS BIGINT) AS customer_nums,
       CAST(customer_vip_nums AS BIGINT) AS customer_vip_nums,
       CAST(customer_vip_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS customer_vip_money,
       CAST(receive_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS receive_money,
       CAST(item_sale_cost AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS item_sale_cost,
       CAST(item_sale_profit AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS item_sale_profit,
       CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS computed_at,
       CAST((SELECT count(DISTINCT branch_num) FROM input WHERE matched) AS INTEGER) AS chunk_n_matched
FROM input
WHERE matched
UNION ALL
-- 占位行（#1314）：本块 0 家门店有数据时写 1 行，保证父侧「分块到齐」判据成立
SELECT '${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}',CAST(${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK} AS INTEGER),
       CAST('${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}' AS DATE),
       CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS time_period,
       CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS customer_nums,
       CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS customer_vip_nums,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS customer_vip_money,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS receive_money,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS item_sale_cost,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS item_sale_profit,
       CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ),
       CAST(0 AS INTEGER)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM input WHERE matched)
